name: Precision Oncology & Variant Dissonance
description: Clinical variant interpretation multigraph resolving conflicting pathogenicity claims (ClinVar) and AlphaFold structural stability across TP53, BRCA1, and PTEN.

gene.name: Human Cancer Gene
gene.description: Human tumor suppressor or oncogene (e.g. TP53, BRCA1, PTEN)

protein_variant.name: Missense Variant
protein_variant.description: Single amino acid substitution causing potential conformational disruption

phenotype.name: Cancer Syndrome / Phenotype
phenotype.description: Malignant disease predisposition (e.g. Li-Fraumeni syndrome, Hereditary Breast & Ovarian Cancer)

structural_domain.name: Structural Domain (AlphaFold)
structural_domain.description: 3D functional domain or catalytic interface determined via AlphaFold 3D coordinates

clinical_evidence.name: Clinical Laboratory Dossier
clinical_evidence.description: Certified diagnostic submission or peer-reviewed functional study (ClinVar / PubMed)

located_in_gene.name: Located in Gene
located_in_gene.description: Maps the missense variant to its parent coding gene locus

maps_to_domain.name: Maps to Structural Domain
maps_to_domain.description: Spatial localization of the substitution within a 3D AlphaFold functional domain

drives_pathogenicity.name: Drives Pathogenicity / Disease
drives_pathogenicity.description: Clinical assertion that the variant causes or elevates risk for the specific cancer phenotype

refutes_pathogenicity.name: Refutes Pathogenicity (Benign / VUS)
refutes_pathogenicity.description: Clinical assertion that the variant is benign, tolerating, or of uncertain significance for the phenotype

destabilizes_core.name: Destabilizes Structural Core
destabilizes_core.description: AlphaFold pLDDT collapse (<50) or steric clash disrupting hydrophobic packing

retains_stable_core.name: Retains Wild-Type Folding
retains_stable_core.description: AlphaFold high-confidence structure (pLDDT >85) showing tolerated solvent-exposed substitution

supported_by.name: Evidenced by Dossier
supported_by.description: Links clinical assertion to primary laboratory submission or functional assay

conflict_rules.name: ClinVar Pathogenicity Dissonance
conflict_rules.description: Clinical Contradiction: Multiple certified clinical diagnostic laboratories submit diametrically opposed clinical classifications (Pathogenic vs. Benign / VUS) for the identical patient missense variant.

conflict_rules.name: AlphaFold Structural Dissonance
conflict_rules.description: Biophysical Contradiction: AlphaFold structural modeling predicts severe core destabilization (pLDDT collapse) while experimental assay reports wild-type structural stability.
